test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Express 0.9 overline{87}-0.7 overline{56} in the form (p)/(q), where p and q are integers and q ≠ 0.
solution: **Calculation** Step 1: Number of 9 in denominator = Number of bars [0.7̅ = 7/9] Step 2: Number of non bar digit = Number of zeros [0.86̅ = (86 - 8)/90 = 78/90 = 13/10]
